update.title: Modernized Python packaging across the tool fleet
update.summary: Replaced runtime path-manipulating launchers with declared Python entry points, then updated services and integrations to call stable installed commands.

blocks.body:
## Give each tool a declared command

Python command tools expose their CLIs through `pyproject.toml` entry points and editable installs. Source edits remain immediately available, while callers use stable command names instead of launcher scripts that rewrite Python’s import path.

blocks.description: A declared entry point maps a stable command name to its package-owned implementation.

blocks.body:
## Move consumers onto the command boundary

Systemd units, MCP definitions, desktop launchers, and validation resolve installed commands through `PATH`. Obsolete shims, broken symlinks, and hardcoded source paths are removed as each consumer moves to the package-owned entry point.

## Keep module resolution deterministic

Packages with unique module paths use installed entry points throughout. Where flat-layout tools share a generic top-level module name, integration definitions use an explicit source command so imports cannot resolve to the wrong package.
